title: Leida Mothma
subtitle: Independent
description: At only 13 years old, young Leida Mothma rebelled against her parents, hewing to the old traditions of Chendrila and its ancient customs. Her parents, Moh Mothma and Perrin Fertha, were surprised by her interest in the old ways, especially in such modern times. With such intense friction in the family, it was no wonder she bristled under her mother's parenting.
